cases.sentence: Он обстроил ее кругом от Милло до ___, а Иоав отстроил остальные части города.
cases.explain: «окружной стены» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

cases.sentence: Он обстроил ее кругом от Милло до окружной стены, а Иоав отстроил ___ города.
cases.explain: «остальные части» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

cases.sentence: Давид тогда был в укреплении, а ___ разместился в Вифлееме.
cases.explain: «филистимский отряд» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

cases.sentence: Тогда те трое пробились через филистимский лагерь, зачерпнули воды из колодца у ___ и принесли Давиду.
cases.explain: «вифлеемских ворот» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to Yahweh,

cases.sentence: Ванея, сын Иодая, был ___ из Кавцеила, совершившим великие подвиги.
cases.explain: «доблестным воином» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

cases.sentence: Еще он спустился в ров в ___ и убил там льва.
cases.explain: «снежный день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.
